claim: When other routines enter a set-up past its start, the hook cannot tell whose figure it is from IX alone: the game's own entry must mark the draw, and an event that starts mid-draw must be given what earlier hooks left.

evidence.text: The game's own entry marks a draw (a byte in hook RAM); the draw hook places sprites only for a marked draw, so the two routines that call the set-up past its start change no sprite; an event that starts mid-draw has to be given what the hooks before it left, or all 794 draws failed.
